agent.summary: Could not reproduce the regression: with SuppressSourceGeneration=true the analyzer still reports MsgPack004, 007 and 015 in the test harness, and TypeCollector/analyzer code contains no gate that silences diagnostics except the intentional MsgPack016/017 skips. No source changes were made. I added one passing analyzer test covering diagnostics under suppression, which does not fail without a change. The real trigger is likely a scenario not yet identified, possibly the MsgPack011 skip or a build/IDE-level behaviour outside these unit tests.
